title: Click Game
description: Test your reflexes and see how fast you can click.
about:
Click Game is a browser game where you choose a target category, press Play and click the requested items to build a score.

Start a round in your browser and use the controls below to play.
howToPlay: Choose a target category, press Play and click the requested items to build a score.

controls.action: Choose a category and select targets

tips: Use click / tap to choose a category and select targets.
Try another round to practice the timing and strategy.

faq.question: How do I play Click Game?
faq.answer: Choose a target category, press Play and click the requested items to build a score.

faq.question: Can I play Click Game in a browser?
faq.answer: Yes. Open the game page and play without installing an app.
